title: Unit 18 Consolidation: the Great Depression
goal: Review the crisis of 1929 and its effects on Latin America, with the grammar of Unit 18.

items: I can tell what had already happened before the crash, using the pluperfect.
I can explain a surprising result of the crisis, using *sin embargo* or *no obstante*.
I can compare how badly places were hit, using superlatives.
I can describe how governments protected their industries, using *mediante*.
I can sum up the effects of 1929 for the region, using argument markers.
